A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same LogiDynamics paper, including complete Appendices A–E. Text comparison and rendering establish identical content throughout, apart from the first-page arXiv stamp and its hyperlink.

before.justification: v2 reports original model evaluations on five reasoning and in-context learning datasets, plus inference-scaling experiments in Sections 4–6 and detailed results in Appendix E.

after.justification: v3 retains these original benchmark and inference-scaling results, including the detailed model-level accuracy tables in Appendix E.

M1.justification: The inference pipelines in Section 2.2, hypothesis selection and verification/refinement procedures in Section 6, and prompts in Appendix D are identical.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate E-KAR, VASR, RAVEN, List Function, and SALT with the same modalities, difficulty categories, and task-format coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout: direct induction, automated inference, and abduction plus deduction remain in corresponding experiments, alongside the same reasoning-model comparisons in Table 4.

E3.justification: Dataset counts, difficulty thresholds, accuracy metrics, MCQ/FTG procedures, evaluated model configurations, and hypothesis-sampling and refinement settings are identical.

E4.justification: The analyses of modality, difficulty, and task format, and the sampling-size, refinement-round, and combined scaling analyses in Figure 4 are retained without revision.

E5.justification: Figure 1(b)'s error-bar displays and statistical reporting throughout the paper are unchanged. No run-count, seed, or uncertainty-estimation information is added or revised.

E6.justification: All reported numerical values, plotted results, and qualitative findings match, including Tables 2–4 and Appendix E's Tables 7–15. Table 4 retains Deepseek-V3 accuracies of 57.2%, 65.2%, and 69.6% for unscaled, low-scaling, and high-scaling settings.

T1.justification: The analogical-reasoning definition in Section 2.1 and formal task constraints in Section 5 are identical. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about modality-, difficulty-, and task-format-dependent inference performance, generalization to explicit-function ICL tasks, and inference scaling.

C2.justification: Explanations of rule-execution failures, hypothesis-selection saturation, and refinement effectiveness are unchanged. Both versions retain the limitation to reasoning frameworks for static LLMs.

D1.justification: Appendices A–D retain identical model details, temperatures, difficulty annotations, SALT construction instructions, and prompts. The resource link and code/data access information are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 7, the bibliography, and comparisons with prior research are identical; no cited works or substantive positioning claims change.

P1.justification: The first-page margin stamp changes from arXiv v2, 9 Apr 2025, to v3, 30 Aug 2025, and gains a manuscript hyperlink. The title, authors, prose, terminology, and section structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–4, Tables 1–15, prompt boxes, captions, and page layout are unchanged. Rendered pages 2–21 are pixel-identical; page 1 differs only in the margin stamp text.

improvement.justification: The main text and Appendices A–E retain identical scientific content, results, reproducibility information, and presentation. Updating the arXiv stamp and adding its manuscript hyperlink produces no meaningful change in overall paper quality.
